rule_text_verbatim:
**MODEL PICK RULE — fixed before any score of seeds 2–3 exists (the author chose option A, Sun 15 Nov 08:50 KST; written by the author).**

Candidates: Gamma + brightness weight 100 and Gamma + brightness weight 1,000, background bound 0.25, four seeds each (0–3).
Checkpoint for every seed: the **best-validation** checkpoint (the stopping rule declared in the training workflow), never the final epoch.
Scored on: full SELECT only (2,645 tiles), guarded and hash-stamped scorer, pre-stated strict lines.
Rule, in order:
1. The setting with **more seeds (of 4) that meet all of lines 2–5** wins (2 energy ratio in 0.8–1.25; 3 flag ratio in 0.5–2 with hit rate ≥ 0.5; 4 hottest-cell share ≥ 0.33; 5 amount at 3 km delivers).
2. If equal: the setting with **more line passes in total** over lines 2–5 and four seeds (out of 16).
3. If still equal: **weight 1,000**.
The frozen candidate for the one-time closed test is **seed 0** of the winning setting at its best-validation checkpoint (no choosing the best seed).
Line 1 (block ranking vs even spread) is not part of the rule: no Gamma-family run passes it; that is reported as it is.
Seen before this rule was fixed: full scores of seeds 0–1 of both settings; in-training half-sample readings of weight-1,000 seeds 2–3 at epoch 24 (pod log, 08:15). No full score of any seed 2–3 exists. Scoring of seeds 2–3 is on hold until this rule is committed to the repo.
checkpoint: best_val.pt (lowest SELECT validation loss, the stopping rule of the training workflow), never the final epoch; a score file of a '-final' checkpoint is never an input
scored_on: full SELECT only (2,645 tiles), guarded and hash-stamped scorer (scripts/score_run.py with guard and code_sha256 in the score JSON), the pre-stated strict lines

lines_2_to_5.2_energy: energy ratio in [0.8, 1.25]; implemented as amount.pixel.methods.model.ratio_of_sums (the convention of the decision table on wiki/reports/bigdata-training.html)
lines_2_to_5.3_flags: flag-count ratio in [0.5, 2.0] AND block hit rate >= 0.5 (summary.rule.model)

ordered_steps: 1. the setting with MORE seeds (of 4) that meet ALL of lines 2-5 wins
2. if equal: the setting with more line passes in total over lines 2-5 and the four seeds (out of 16)

line_1_not_part_of_the_rule: block ranking vs even spread: no gamma-family run passes it; reported as it is
